messages.author: 395bdca538bcae5d
messages.subject: Updated tmbstan example
parts:
Hi all,

I revised the example at https://github.com/kaskr/tmbstan#examples to give more thorough guidance on how to use tmbstan. This should cover the most frequently asked questions we get and that are sent to this list. Note to run this example you need to install the development version of TMB as well.

Thanks,
Cole
